notes: Four ranks, ordered low to high. The Ritual Cult fields specialist teams only and never a full platoon (see the faction's own weakness), so the ladder is short and canLead is mostly unused; it exists for the same reason the Samurai ladder carries ranks no current unit holds. Waterwalk is the Cult's signature movement trait, matching its marsh-and-reed territory.

ranks.title: Initiate
ranks.description: Newly bound to the rite, still learning the foreign tongue.

ranks.title: Adept
ranks.description: Practiced channeler. Crosses standing water and fords as if they were open ground.

ranks.title: Voice of the Rite
ranks.description: Speaks the rite for others to follow; steadies a circle from nearby.

ranks.title: Hierophant
ranks.description: Eldest of the affiliated channelers, melts into the reeds between rites.

privilegeRules.waterwalk: Water and Ford cost 1 Movement instead of impassable (Water) or 2 (Ford) for ground units; no change for flying.
privilegeRules.hideOnForestStop: Ending a move on a Forest hex applies Hidden.
privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for auras and morale recovery.
